children: The $91 bln IT group unveiled a $1.5 bln contract with the luxury carmaker, which is also selling a consulting unit to the Indian giant. Financial gains look limited, but at least TCS gets expertise and access to more European clients amid the industry's AI-driven revenue crunch.
Full view will be published shortly.
Follow Ujjaini Dutta on LinkedIn and X.
Tata Consultancy Services will buy Porsche AG's automotive and consulting unit MHP at an enterprise value of €320 million, the IT major said on August 24 in a stock exchange filing.
Under the partnership, Porsche has signed a five-year strategic deal with MHP and TCS amounting to €1.25 billion. The deal is expected to close by the end of the year.
